diag.Z0001.title: Unexpected token
diag.Z0001.why: The parser found a token that cannot start or continue the construct before it, or the input ended early.
diag.Z0001.fix: Check the line for a missing operand, bracket or keyword.
diag.Z0002.title: Expected a specific token
diag.Z0002.why: The construct requires a particular token (such as ';', ')' or ':') and found something else.
diag.Z0002.fix: Insert the missing token, or end the previous statement with ';' or a newline.
diag.Z0003.title: Invalid or unterminated literal
diag.Z0003.why: A string, template, regular expression or comment is not closed, or a character is not valid in the source.
diag.Z0003.fix: Close the literal on the same line (strings) or remove the stray character.
diag.Z0004.title: Invalid assignment target
diag.Z0004.why: Only a variable, a property (a.b) or an element (a[i]) can be assigned to.
diag.Z0004.fix: Assign to a variable or property instead.
diag.Z0005.title: Syntax not supported yet
diag.Z0005.why: The syntax is valid TypeScript but this engine does not implement it yet.
diag.Z0005.fix: Rewrite it with supported syntax, or wait for the task that adds it.
diag.Z0006.title: `class` in JSX: write `className`
diag.Z0006.why: JSX is the language React defines: `class` is a keyword of JavaScript and TypeScript, so the attribute that carries the style classes, and the prop of a component that takes them, are named `className`.
diag.Z0006.fix: Rename the attribute to className (`<View className="p-4">`) and declare the prop of your components as className; `zinc migrate jsx-classname --apply` rewrites a whole project.
diag.Z0007.title: JSX components start with a capital letter
diag.Z0007.why: As in React and React Native, a JSX tag names a component and components start with a capital letter: `<View>`, `<Text>`, `<Button>`, `<Image>`, `<ScrollView>`, `<Canvas>`, `<Input>`, `<TextArea>` or one of yours. A lowercase tag is not a component of Zinc.
diag.Z0007.fix: Write the capitalised component the message names: `<view>` is `<View>`, `<scroll>` is `<ScrollView>`; `zinc migrate jsx-capitalised-tags --apply` rewrites a whole project.
diag.Z0101.title: Cannot find name
diag.Z0101.why: The identifier is not declared in this scope, or is declared later in the same scope.
diag.Z0101.fix: Declare it before use, or fix the spelling.
diag.Z0102.title: Duplicate declaration
diag.Z0102.why: A name can be declared only once per scope.
diag.Z0103.title: Type is not assignable
diag.Z0103.why: The value's type cannot be used where another type is expected. Machine numeric kinds (i32, f64, ...) are distinct: only lossless widening is implicit, and conditions must be boolean. `number` is f64 (f32 or fixed point on some boards, see --profile); messages say number.
diag.Z0103.fix: Convert explicitly or change the declared type.
diag.Z0104.title: Wrong number of arguments
diag.Z0104.why: A call must pass every required parameter and no more than the function declares.
diag.Z0105.title: Expression is not callable
diag.Z0105.why: Only functions and methods can be called, and only classes can be used with new.
diag.Z0105.fix: Call a function, or remove the parentheses.
diag.Z0106.title: Property does not exist
diag.Z0106.why: The type has no member with this name, or the builtin library does not provide it yet.
diag.Z0106.fix: Check the name against the type's declaration.
diag.Z0107.title: Operator cannot be applied to these types
diag.Z0107.why: The operands' types do not support the operator.
diag.Z0107.fix: Convert the operands or use another operator.
diag.Z0108.title: Cannot assign to a constant
diag.Z0108.why: A const binding or read-only member cannot be reassigned.
diag.Z0108.fix: Declare it with let, or do not assign.
diag.Z0109.title: Cannot infer a type
diag.Z0109.why: Parameters and class fields need an annotation, a declaration needs an initializer, and a function that calls itself needs a return type, when the type cannot be inferred.
diag.Z0110.title: Not all code paths return a value
diag.Z0110.why: A function with a non-void return type must return on every path.
diag.Z0111.title: Field is not initialized
diag.Z0111.why: A field without an initializer must be assigned in the constructor.
diag.Z0111.fix: Initialize it or assign it in the constructor.
diag.Z0112.title: Not allowed in this context
diag.Z0112.why: break and continue need an enclosing loop, return needs a function, this needs a class.
diag.Z0113.title: Expression cannot be indexed or iterated
diag.Z0113.why: Only arrays can be indexed or used with for...of for now.
diag.Z0114.title: Invalid class hierarchy or override
diag.Z0114.why: A class must extend a class, an override must keep the base member's kind and type, and the hierarchy must not loop.
diag.Z0114.fix: Match the base class member, or rename the member.
diag.Z0115.title: Abstract member misused
diag.Z0115.why: Abstract classes cannot be instantiated, abstract members belong in abstract classes, and a concrete class must implement every abstract member it inherits.
diag.Z0115.fix: Implement the member, or make the class abstract.
diag.Z0116.title: Class does not implement the interface
diag.Z0116.why: A class that declares `implements I` must have a public member for every member of I with the same type.
diag.Z0116.fix: Add the missing member or fix its type.
diag.Z0117.title: Member is not accessible
diag.Z0117.why: A private member is visible only inside its class, a protected member inside its class and subclasses.
diag.Z0117.fix: Use a public member or access it from inside the class.
diag.Z0118.title: Invalid super call
diag.Z0118.why: A derived class constructor must start with `super(...)`, and `super` is only valid in a derived class.
diag.Z0118.fix: Call super(...) as the first statement of the constructor.
diag.Z0119.title: Cannot find module
diag.Z0119.why: An import must name a file relative to the importing file ('./x' or '../x'); `.ts`, `.tsx` and `/index.ts` are tried.
diag.Z0119.fix: Fix the path or create the file.
diag.Z1001.title: `var` is not supported
diag.Z1001.why: `var` hoists and has function scope, which a typed engine cannot give a static meaning to.
diag.Z1002.title: `arguments` is not supported
diag.Z1002.why: The `arguments` object is an untyped list of every argument.
diag.Z1002.fix: Use explicit parameters, or a rest parameter.
diag.Z1003.title: `eval` is not supported
diag.Z1003.why: A program is compiled ahead of time: there is no engine to run text at run time.
diag.Z1003.fix: Parse the data (JSON.parse) or call a function.
diag.Z1005.title: `with` is not supported
diag.Z1005.why: `with` changes name resolution at run time.
diag.Z1005.fix: Name the object: `o.x` instead of `with (o) { x }`.
diag.Z1007.title: `delete` is not supported
diag.Z1007.why: A typed object has a fixed list of fields: a field cannot be removed.
diag.Z1007.fix: Use a Map (`map.delete(key)`), or set the field to null.
diag.Z1009.title: Dynamic `import()` is not supported
diag.Z1009.why: Every module of a program is known when it is compiled.
diag.Z1009.fix: Use a static `import` at the top of the file.
diag.Z1010.title: Prototype mutation is not supported
diag.Z1010.why: Classes have a fixed shape; `prototype` and `__proto__` cannot be written or read.
diag.Z1010.fix: Declare a method in the class, or extend it.
diag.Z1011.title: Arrays with holes are not supported
diag.Z1011.why: An array is a contiguous list: `[1, , 2]` would need a value that is not there.
diag.Z1015.title: `globalThis` is not supported
diag.Z1015.why: There is no global object whose properties can be added or read by name.
diag.Z1015.fix: Import what you need, or keep it in a module.
diag.Z9026.title: The `in` operator is not supported on a typed value
diag.Z9026.why: The properties of a typed object are fixed, so `"a" in o` is known when compiling.
diag.Z9026.fix: Use `Map.has(key)`, or compare to the field.
diag.Z5005.title: A plugin needs a capability the target does not have
diag.Z5005.why: A plugin's plugin.json "requires" lists the platform capabilities it needs (heap>=4M, fs, dynlib...); the profile in force must offer them.
diag.Z5005.fix: Build for a target that has them, or pass --force to build anyway.
diag.Z5006.title: A system module needs a permission
diag.Z5006.why: The modules `zinc:system/<feature>` (notification, menu, tray, dialog, window, shortcut, instance, deeplink, autostart, dock, power, clipboard, opener) are denied unless zinc.json lists the permission `"<feature>"` (or `"<feature>:<operation>"`); a project without "permissions" can use none. The host features (net, fs, process, serial, camera, microphone, location) are checked at run time by their modules once zinc.json has "permissions": zinc:camera's devices() and open() fail naming "camera" in an exported app.
diag.Z5006.fix: Add the id to "permissions" in zinc.json.
diag.Z5010.title: A native member uses a type the native ABI cannot carry yet
diag.Z5010.why: A native module is called with scalars (i32, u32, boolean, f64), strings, and arrays of u8, i32 and f64; its Spec lists the members. Callbacks, promises, resources and other number kinds are not expressible yet.
diag.Z5010.fix: Change the member to use one of those types.
diag.Z5011.title: The native module is not linked into this engine
diag.Z5011.why: `requireNative<Spec>('Name')` needs the module registered in the engine (or a stand-in next to the spec, x.next.ts or x.sim.ts) with the export and signature the Spec describes.
diag.Z5011.fix: Link the module, add a stand-in, or fix the Spec to match the module.
diag.Z5012.title: A worker's message type is not data
diag.Z5012.why: A worker shares nothing with its parent: each message is copied as data. Numbers, i32, u32, booleans, strings, u8[] buffers, arrays, T | null and records (interfaces and object types of those) cross; maps, sets, functions and class instances do not.
diag.Z5012.fix: Send a record of the data instead (a Map as an array of [key, value] records, an object as its fields).
diag.Z5013.title: A worker's file is not named by a literal
diag.Z5013.why: A worker is a second program compiled with this one, so its file must be known at build time: a string literal, or `new URL('./file.ts', import.meta.url)`.
diag.Z5013.fix: Write the worker's path as a literal.
diag.Z4001.title: The value cannot be represented in fixed point
diag.Z4001.why: Under a fixed-point profile (`--profile ps1`, or `// zinc-profile: ps1`) `number` is Q20.12: no Infinity and no NaN, so Math.min() and Math.max() with no argument (which are Infinity and -Infinity) have no value.
diag.Z4001.fix: Give the call at least one argument.
diag.Z1006.title: `any` is not allowed in a strict profile
diag.Z1006.why: A strict profile (the line `// zinc-profile: strict` at the top of the entry file, or `--strict`) keeps every value statically typed: `any` and the untyped result of JSON.parse are the gradual (Dyn) part of the language.
diag.Z1006.fix: Give the value a type, use `unknown` and narrow it, or drop the strict profile.
diag.detail.readBeforeAssigned: '{name}' is read before it is assigned
diag.detail.notExportedNear: '{name}' is not exported by '{module}' (did you mean '{guess}'?)
diag.detail.narrowNull: '{type}' must be narrowed first (it may be null)
diag.detail.noDom: '{name}': Zinc runs without a browser, so there is no DOM. Draw with `zinc:gfx`, or build screens with `zinc:ui`.
diag.detail.noDomMember: '{name}' on 'Document': Zinc runs without a browser, so there is no DOM (document only says whether the window is visible). Draw with `zinc:gfx`, or build screens with `zinc:ui`.
diag.detail.noStorage: '{name}': Zinc runs without a browser. `zinc:storage` keeps values between runs.
diag.detail.noPlugin: '{spec}' is not a module of the engine and no plugin of this project provides it (`zinc plugins` lists the ones it has, `zinc plugins search {name}` looks in the index, `zinc add <name>` installs one)
diag.detail.nodeModule: '{spec}' is a module of Node.js. Zinc has `{module}` instead.
diag.detail.react: '{spec}': React in Zinc is `zinc:ui/react`. With the "react-native" preset in zinc.json, '{spec}' is imported as it is.
diag.detail.npm: '{spec}' (no tsconfig.json paths entry maps it). An npm package is installed with `zinc add npm:{package}` and runs with `--engine quickjs`.
diag.detail.jsxCapital: JSX: <{tag}> is not a component: components start with a capital letter (<View>, <Text>, <Button>, <Image>, <ScrollView>, <Canvas>, <Input>, <TextArea>, or one of yours)
diag.detail.jsxWrite: JSX: <{tag}> is not a component: write <{want}>
diag.detail.jsxClassName: JSX: write className, not class, on <{tag}>
diag.detail.jsxNotClosed: JSX: {open} is not closed: add {close}, or end the tag with />
diag.detail.jsxClosedBy: JSX: {open} is not closed (line {line} closes {other} instead): add {close}, or end the tag with />
diag.hint.errors_other: zinc: {count} errors, start with the first.
diag.hint.js: If it is plain JavaScript, name the file {js}: `zinc run {js}` runs it as it is.
